verdict.rationale: Buzz has its own workflow engine. It can run workflows (buzz-gh-2), has `buzz workflows trigger`/`approve` CLI commands (buzz-docs-8), and VISION.md claims "YAML-as-code automation. Traces." (buzz-docs-13). The buzz-acp harness also fires agents automatically on @mention events (buzz-docs-10). However, the evidence never shows users writing rules that bind specific events to actions; the only documented triggers are a manual CLI trigger and the built-in @mention listener. Missing for 10: documented event-trigger syntax for workflows (e.g. on-message/on-push), a catalog of supported events and actions, first-party docs beyond the one-line vision claim, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
